method: scripts/review_patches.py --original <pre-bug sources> --tasks <SWE-smith tasks>: each passing patch is applied to the buggy files and compared with the source before the bug was injected. Residuals were judged by hand: equivalent (dead code, comments, blank lines, equivalent rewrites), weak-mild (differs only in an edge property), weak-strong (part of the injected bug remains, or wrong on ordinary input). Round-4 residuals that matched a round-3 pattern take its judgement; new patterns were judged the same way.
